change: Removed 'Upper Traps' from the primary mid back entry. Sources consistently cite lats (esp. lower fibers) plus rhomboids and MIDDLE/LOWER traps as the worked back muscles on the Meadows row; upper traps are not a meaningful mover in this horizontal pulling angle. Kept Rhomboids + Lower Traps as primary mid back. All other muscles (rear delt, biceps, forearms, obliques for unilateral anti-rotation, rotator cuff) confirmed as secondary.

No muscle change. Verified narrow stance is quad-dominant (esp. vastus lateralis) with reduced posterior-chain demand. Quads + glutes primary, hamstrings + erector spinae secondary confirmed. Adductors are engaged but the Adductors bucket has no further breakdown and was not added to avoid inflation; noted as minor uncertainty.
No change. Hamstrings, glutes, erector spinae primary; quads, traps/rhomboids, obliques (anti-rotation from offset load), forearms (grip) secondary all confirmed by sources.
No change. Glutes (max + medius) primary; hamstrings, quads, erector spinae secondary confirmed. Single-leg version raises glute medius/stabilizer demand, consistent with current encoding.

No change. Quads + glutes prime movers; shoulders (anterior/lateral delts) held isometric to define the overhead variant, retained as primary per isometric-holder rule. Hamstrings, triceps, abs, calves secondary confirmed. Sources frame shoulders/core as stabilizers; classification kept as-is given the defining overhead hold.
